better.line: Doesn't always make me feel better

Just less alone

stanza: All my friends say that of course it's

Ended up becoming something other than what I had planned to be

Left there to dream of their happiness

stanza: You've got to get up every morning with a smile on your face
And show the world all the love in your heart
Then people gonna treat you better
You're gonna find, yes, you will
That you're beautiful as you feel

stanza: Little ghetto boy
When, when, when you become a man

You've gotta fight to make it better

If I didn't know better

stanza: God and I, we correspond with intermittent letters

stanza: She asked if I remembered the letters I wrote

letter.line: Teacher: Alright people, I'm gonna write something on the board. Let's spell it…

stanza: Gray November
I've been down since July
Motion capture
Put me in a bad light

Trying to find the one where I went wrong
Writing letters
Addressed to the fire

letter.line: Two of us sending postcards, writing letters
stanza: Two of us sending postcards, writing letters
On my wall

stanza: My dog barks wildly
To protect my infancy
From my ex-believer
And I try to calm the wolf
To remind her I am both
Still she tears at my sweater

sweater.line: I was cold, so I put on a sweater
stanza: On the morning when I woke up without you for the first time
I was cold, so I put on a sweater
And I turned up the heat
And the walls began to close in
And I felt so sad and frightened
I practically ran from the living room out into the street
And the wind began to blow and all the trees began to bend
And the world in its cold way started coming alive
And I stood there like a businessman waiting for a train
And I got ready for the future to arrive
